interpretation_notes: Multiple passages in the selected 2004 series identify agneya/southeast as the primary kitchen location. Some traditions and practical guidance permit alternatives such as northwest when southeast is unavailable; Phase 20 does not silently encode those alternatives because their precedence requires domain review. The rule remains SOFT and cannot override statutory, structural, fire-safety or accessibility constraints.
normalized_statement: Prefer the kitchen in the southeast zone of the dwelling.
